title: ToolAlignBench: Investigating Alignment Conflicts in Tool-Calling Enabled LLMs
reasoning: The paper introduces ToolAlignBench, a benchmark designed to evaluate value hierarchy conflicts in LLM agents. It specifically assesses how models navigate ethical dilemmas and moral judgments, such as whether to whistleblow on organizational wrongdoing (prioritizing public safety values) or comply with internal logging instructions (prioritizing deployment directives).
